preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(P) <= 1000000 for P in passages)
preconditions.description: Length of each passage P is between 1 and 1,000,000.
Total length of all passages across all test cases is at most 5,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in '#.' for c in P) for P in passages)
preconditions.description: Each passage P consists only of the characters '#' and '.'.

preconditions.expression: all(P[0] == '#' and P[-1] == '#' for P in passages)
preconditions.description: The first and last characters of each passage P are '#'.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines is equal to the number of test cases T.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(day_count, int) and day_count >= 0 for day_count in output)
postconditions.description: Each output line contains a non-negative integer representing the number of days it takes to cross the corresponding passage.
